product.name: Monoprice Video/Audio Splitter - HDMI Male to 2x HDMI Female
product.description: This passive splitter will distribute a single HDMI® input to two HDMI outputs. The single HDMI plug and two HDMI ports are gold plated to ensure smooth, corrosion-free connections.Note that this splitter does not pass the HDCP™ copy protection information, so it is unsuited for use in home theater systems. Please use one of our powered splitters for home theater applications.HDMI®, the HDMI Logo, and High-Definition Multimedia Interface are trademarks or registered trademarks of HDMI Licensing LLC in the United States and other countries.
